description: S Narasimhamurthy, a Bengaluru based priest, produced and directed the Kannada film ‘Love You’ which is being called the first fully AI generated feature film in the world.
body_lead: Bengaluru priest helms world's first AI film in Kannada on Rs 10 lakh budget Narasimha Murthy, a Bengaluru-based priest, produced and directed the Kannada film 'Love You', which is being called the first AI-generated feature film in the world. Narasimha Murthy, a priest from Siddehalli village near Bengaluru, has surprised the Kannada film industry by claiming to have directed the world’s first full-length feature film entirely created using Artificial Intelligence (AI).
